[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Arts Major in Asian Language and Studies Concentration in Chinese","groupId":"11a71dcc-aed2-4e7c-9c3a-0194af7a169a","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and major/program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the bachelor of arts degree with a major in Asian Language Studies and a concentration in Chinese.

","groupId":"5db5c93f-1cea-4b91-80c7-0194af7a169a","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"ce9f87d9-488d-4703-9102-0194af7aee7a","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include:

","groupId":"ccb81eaa-290e-4875-b40d-0194af7aee7a","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" CORE Seminars (2 courses)","groupId":"24216f46-eabe-45c6-975a-0194af7d2cbd","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.  

","groupId":"1884c4d5-931a-4271-a318-0194af7d2cbd","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"6c8017ae-459b-4e98-b285-0194af7df403","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

3) Students must complete 60 units outside the primary discipline of the first major, regardless of the department that offers the course(s) in that discipline. (This includes general education courses, transfer courses, CPCE/EXTN units, internships, etc.)

","groupId":"19eb183d-f7c6-40f0-b001-0194af7df404","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"d4043eaa-f70f-4a05-ba46-0194af7e7fac","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"1cfe8be3-c0d4-4693-9727-0194af7e7fac","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"eb250b55-0b5f-42c8-a2ec-0194af7f19d6","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"02067392-ef11-47af-b758-0194af7f19d6","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"e13ff4a1-1dfa-4dda-821b-0194af7fb491","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes: 

1) Language requirement begins with the intermediate level; at least one semester (or a summer with a minimum of 8 weeks) of language requirement must be completed in China or Taiwan. 

2) No more than two equivalent courses (as determined by the advisor) may be completed while studying in China/Taiwan.
